column1: # Test Case H: Contention Bursts (Dean / Faculty / Student at the same tick)
# Every 4 ticks a burst of four jobs arrives at the SAME time: one Dean
# one Faculty/Staff and two Students. In the --demo run each job belongs to
# four threads wake on the same clock tick and race for the shared mutex.
# Each burst brings ~15 pages but only 4 ticks pass before the next one
# work piles up in all three queues and they compete for the printer.
